decision.observation: 4 mph, gear 1, timer 45:33.250, red X lit. The car is on grass about a car width right of the gravel; the road has curved left ahead of it and the nose still points up-frame, so the A beat barely changed the heading. White house on the right, white fence left.
decision.hypothesis: The car's screen x stayed ~centre while the road curved away left, so the short A beat was too weak, not mis-signed; at 4 mph a longer 1 s W+A should actually turn the nose left onto the gravel.
decision.memory: Short 0.5-0.6 s steer beats at 4-5 mph are too weak to close even a one-car-width gap on a left bend; use ~1 s holds while the car is below ~7 mph.
